LESSON: WEAVING CRAFT

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PAPER
Topic 5.1: Weaving CRAFT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Weaving CRAFT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Where can weave articles be used?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. make weaves using paper for creativity
2. appreciate the use of local materials for making woven articles technique. their choice to weave article. work and share comments Core-Competence Learning to learn Communication and Collaboration

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. make weaves using paper for creativity
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to make weaves using paper for creativity. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the use of local materials for making woven articles technique. their choice to weave article. work and share comments Core-Competence Learning to learn Communication and Collaboration
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the use of local materials for making woven articles technique. their choice to weave article. work and share comments Core-Competence Learning to learn Communication and Collaboration. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Weaving CRAFT.
2. Explain Weaving CRAFT to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Weaving CRAFT.
4. Show that you can: make weaves using paper for creativity
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Weaving CRAFT. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Where can weave articles be used?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. make weaves using paper for creativity
2. appreciate the use of local materials for making woven articles technique. their choice to weave article. work and share comments Core-Competence Learning to learn Communication and Collaboration

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
